purpose: Replace the flat checkpoint ring in playable/gates.js. One GLB cloned along the piste.
required_parts: spring hinge above a screw base
small flag panel on the inner side of each pole
relations: origin is the snow point halfway between the poles
pole centers are 8 m apart on local X
shafts stand on local Z in Blender, which is up after glTF Y-up export
flags face Blender +Y, which becomes glTF -Z, toward the skier
screw base extends below the snow origin so the hinge sits on the surface
GateTint is white so the game can color the next, hit, miss, and waiting states
GateHardware keeps the green hinge and metal collar

surface_targets: flag with a hem and a slight billow

review_questions: Do the two poles read as a gate you ski between, rather than a halo?
Does the hinge explain how the pole meets the snow?
Does the flag read from the front without spanning the gap?
assumptions: Real FIS Type A shaft is 30 mm and has no flag. Game shaft is 72 mm so it survives the chase camera. The flag is a game marker, not a giant-slalom banner.
Hit test stays the existing 10 m circle. The visual gap is 8 m, inside that circle.
